subject.title: fix(cron): stop retrying permanent billing errors returned as HTTP 429

question: After redacted runtime proof is attached and the exact-head checks finish, should the maintainer accept billing classification as terminal precedence over HTTP 429 message matching for cron retries?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit maintainer handling, and the remaining merge gate is behavioral proof rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Approve after runtime proof
options.body: Confirm one real scheduled billing-classified failure terminates after one attempt and a genuine rate-limit failure still receives the established retry delay, then land if exact-head checks are green.

options.title: Request a narrower proof plan
options.body: Keep the change open and specify the acceptable redacted runtime artifact if provider credentials or live billing reproduction make the proposed proof impractical.

recommendation.title: Approve after runtime proof
recommendation.body: Confirm one real scheduled billing-classified failure terminates after one attempt and a genuine rate-limit failure still receives the established retry delay, then land if exact-head checks are green.
